dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with jagged, high-frequency spatial transitions from light grey to dark charcoal. A primary elongated 'C' shape is centrally located, with secondary incomplete 'O' shapes situated dorsally and posteriorly.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of isolated, solid high-intensity white pixels (blobs) primarily concentrated in the inter-annuli regions along the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the central 'C' structure, the dorsal-most 'O' fragment, and the posterior-most annulus form a scalene triangle with an obtuse angle at the central centroid.
